title: Versatile Video Representation via Feed-Forward 2D Gaussian Splatting Tokenization
abstract: Recent video representation methods that rely on fixed-grid, patch-wise tokenization often exhibit limited versatility.Spatially, uniformly allocating a fixed number of tokens often leads to over-encoding in low-information regions. Temporally, reducing redundancy remains challenging without explicitly distinguishing between static and dynamic content. In this work, we introduce the Gaussian Video Transformer (GVT), a versatile video representation framework built on a feed-forward 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) tokenization scheme. We first extract latent rigid features from a video clip and represent them with a set of 2D Gaussians generated by our proposed Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Embedding (STGE) mechanism in a feed-forward manner. Such 2D Gaussians not only enhance spatial adaptability by assigning higher (resp., lower) rendering weights to regions with higher (resp., lower) information content during rasterization, but also improve generalization by avoiding per-video optimization. To enhance the temporal versatility, we introduce a Gaussian Set Partitioning (GSP) strategy that separates the 2D Gaussians into static and dynamic sets, which explicitly model static content shared across different time-steps and dynamic content specific to each time-step, enabling a compact representation. We evaluate GVT across four tasks: video reconstruction, video action recognition, video compression, and video generation, on the UCF101, Kinetics, and DAVIS datasets. The results demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction and compression performance, improved action recognition, and video generation performance comparable to the baseline MAGVIT-v2.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 ACM Multimedia 2026 对应的 arXiv 2508.11183v2 全文整理；PDF 未提供可核验的项目页或代码仓库 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: 把固定网格 video tokens 改写为可学习的 2D Gaussian sets：feed-forward encoder 直接预测 Gaussian 的位置、协方差与 coefficient，再显式区分跨帧复用的 static primitives 和逐帧更新的 dynamic primitives。
methodFlow: 把 video clip 编码为逐时间步的 rigid latent tensor
STGE 用时空 attention 与 deformable fusion 预测 2D Gaussian position、covariance 和 coefficient
GSP 用可微二值 mask 将 primitives 分成跨帧复用的 static set 与逐帧更新的 dynamic set
仅对 Gaussian coefficient 做 vector quantization
将 quantized Gaussians rasterize 回规则 latent grid 并解码视频
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它把 2D Gaussian primitives 做成 feed-forward、content-adaptive、可量化的 video representation，对 Gaussian Embroidery 和更广义的 2D structured representation 有方法迁移价值；static/dynamic primitive allocation 也可作为时序设计表示的参考。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 GVT 在 UCF101/K600 reconstruction 上取得 rFVD 12.6/8.6，表中 MAGVIT-v2 为 16.7/24.3（Table 1, p. 6）。消融中，无 GSP 的 rFVD 为 9.2、完整 GVT 为 12.6，但平均 tokens 从 2,560 降到 1,868（Table 5, p. 7），因此 GSP 体现的是压缩与质量 trade-off，而不是单调提升 reconstruction quality。
analysis.caveatZh: 这些 primitives 最终仍 rasterize 回规则 latent grid，没有对象、部件、图层或可编辑语义。static/dynamic 分类仅由更新模式和 reconstruction objective 驱动；generation 只是低分辨率 UCF101 unconditional probe，作者也明确称其为 preliminary evidence。
analysis.motivationZh: 固定网格 patch tokenization 会在低信息区域过度编码，也难以显式消除视频中的时间冗余；传统 Gaussian video representations 又常依赖逐视频优化，缺少快速、通用的 tokenization。
analysis.methodZh: MAGVIT-v2 风格 encoder 先产生 rigid latent tensor；Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Embedding 结合 temporal/spatial attention 与 deformable fusion，预测连续 position、covariance 和 coefficient。Gaussian Set Partitioning 用可微 mask 复用首帧 static Gaussians，仅更新 dynamic subset；coefficient 经 VQ 后再 rasterize 为规则 latent grid并解码。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 UCF101、Kinetics-600/400 与 DAVIS-2017-480P 上评估 reconstruction、action recognition、compression 和 unconditional generation。结果支持 feed-forward Gaussian tokenization 与时空建模的有效性；但 baseline 的 token dimensions、counts 与训练预算并不完全等价，且缺少 Gaussian count、covariance、coefficient-only VQ、partition threshold 以及 primitive editability 的系统消融。
analysis.insightZh: content-adaptive Gaussian allocation 可以替代固定 patch grid，并用 static/dynamic partition 换取更紧凑的时序表示；但有效 tokenizer 与可编辑 design representation 是两个层级，不能由 reconstruction/compression 指标直接互相替代。
